generated_rsp.crc_behavior: unzip reports Bad CRC after the CRC fields in both ZIP local headers and central directory are changed; payload bytes remain unchanged

limitations: Minecraft client was not launched in this environment; the pack has not been live-tested in game.
Java ZipFile and Java ZIP filesystem smoke tests read entry bytes, but this does not guarantee all Minecraft versions or non-Java tools ignore CRC.
Bad CRC is not encryption. Some tools may still save/extract data; CRC can be ignored or repaired and ZIP can be repacked.
Only RSP ZIPs created by the website Model/Item “Tạo ZIP” flows are modified. Hosted input pack segments and the deploy ZIP itself retain valid CRCs.
